brace-expansion GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg uses vulnerable_versions <=5.0.7, which falsely matches 1.x/2.x. v5 is overridden to 5.0.8; 1.x/2.x are on patched 1.1.16/2.1.2 for the related DoS advisories.

image-size ICNS parser DoS (GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr); no patched version exists upstream. Transitive dev/build dependency of metro (React Native bundler), not present in shipped runtime bundles and never fed attacker-controlled input.

extract-zip unvalidated symlink path traversal (GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv); no patched version exists upstream. Transitive dev-only dependency of puppeteer-core; only extracts trusted Puppeteer/Chromium download artifacts, never user-supplied zips.
